original_ai_output.title_zh: 西共体向加纳6月29日洪灾受灾者捐赠25万美元
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳外交部长塞缪尔·奥库泽托·阿布拉克瓦宣布，西非国家经济共同体（西共体）提供25万美元救济款，用于支持加纳6月洪灾的受灾者。该消息目前仅由单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 西共体向加纳6月洪灾受灾者提供25万美元救济款
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: ECOWAS donates $250,000 to support Ghana’s June 29 flood victims

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa has announced a $250,000 relief contribution from the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) to support victims of the June floods in Ghana.
